verdict.rationale: Docs cover the full programmatic account-opening flow (Person/Business/Account Application, KYC/KYB integration), a dedicated free Developer Sandbox with API keys distinct from production, and a pre-launch checklist implying sandbox-to-production parity before go-live. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that sandbox behavior truly mirrors production (parity) and explicit proof accounts are FDIC-insured deposit accounts rather than just 'bank accounts'.
